message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: Pan transferred his own homestead land (宅基地) to Li for 7000 yuan, Li got land use certificate, etc. Then Pan, using concealment, sold the same land again to victim Su, obtaining 30,000 yuan. That's a false contract to obtain money: contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also earlier Pan had prior conviction for illegal acquisition and illegal logging (非法收购盗伐、滥伐的林木罪). But that is prior, not part of current case. The current conduct is fraud using land transfer contract. So charge: 合同诈骗. According to correction rule: If facts describe false contract to obtain money, classify as “合同诈骗” rather than generic “诈骗”. Also when listing crime name(s) between tags, output only statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we output "合同诈骗". Any other crimes? Possibly also "非法占用农用地" but not mentioned. The act of selling land that is not his after already transferred could be considered "诈骗" but we use specific. No other offenses. So single crime.

Return JSON with reasoning and final_answer containing [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>. Ensure format: final_answer string includes that.
